annotations.title: List open jobs from company ATS boards

description: List every open job for a list of companies, read from their own applicant tracking system boards: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Personio, Recruitee, Rippling, Oracle Recruiting, SuccessFactors, Teamtailor, BambooHR, ADP, UKG, Paylocity, and Breezy. Give companies as domains (stripe.com) or board URLs (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir). The board is found from the company site or by name, and a board that names another employer is rejected. Returns one row per job (title, department, location, remote flag, posting date, link, company domain) plus one free company row per company with the board found and job counts, or why no board was read. Optional filters on title, location, department, remote, and posting age; optional descriptions; only_new with a state_key returns only jobs not seen on the last run. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per job row returned and once per run start; company rows are free.

companies.description: One per line: a company domain (stripe.com), a homepage or careers page URL, or a job board URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear, https://workday.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/Workday). To tie a board URL to a domain, join them with an equals sign: gusto.com=https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/gusto. Up to 500 per run

departments.description: Optional. Return only jobs whose department or team contains one of these, ignoring case. Boards that publish no department return nothing under this filter

exclude_title_keywords.description: Optional. Drop jobs whose title contains one of these words or phrases, for example intern

include_description.description: true adds the job description as plain text, up to 20,000 characters, for the jobs returned. No extra charge. Runs take longer on Workday boards, which need one read per job

locations.description: Optional. Return only jobs whose location text contains one of these, ignoring case, for example new york, london, germany. The word remote matches remote jobs

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before it would charge more than this

max_jobs_per_company.description: Job rows returned per company, newest first, after the filters. Default 1000, up to 5000. The whole board is read either way, up to 5,000 postings

only_new.description: true returns only jobs that were not on the board at the last run with the same state key. The first run returns every matching job and records the board

platforms.description: Optional. Limit board discovery to these: greenhouse, lever, ashby, workday, workable, smartrecruiters, personio, recruitee, rippling, oracle_hcm, successfactors, teamtailor, bamboohr, adp, ukg, paylocity, breezy. Empty means all

posted_within_days.description: Optional. Return only jobs posted in the last N days. Jobs with no posting date are left out when this is set. Workday shows 30+ days for older postings, so those count as 30 days old

remote_only.description: true returns only jobs the board marks remote or whose location says remote

reset_state.description: true forgets the saved state for this state key and treats every board as a first run

state_key.description: Names the saved state for only new jobs. Use one key per schedule, for example sales-accounts-daily

title_keywords.description: Optional. Return only jobs whose title contains one of these words or phrases, matched as whole words and ignoring case, for example account executive, sales, engineer

name: list_company_ats_jobs
title: List open jobs from company ATS boards
